statement.zh: 通论（Pollock、Nissen、Algaze、Postgate、Potts）将低地两河冲积平原表述为早期城市、文字行政与国家社会的核心研究区；本条以南部苏美尔/乌鲁克为中心。
statement.en: Handbooks (Pollock, Nissen, Algaze, Postgate, Potts) frame lowland Mesopotamia (Tigris–Euphrates alluvium) as a core region for early cities, administrative writing, and state societies; this entry centers southern Sumer/Uruk developments.
